scope: Frozen-policy supervised sequential scene adaptation; primary detection, secondary next-interval forecasting. No PPO, learned admittance, or hardware online-supervision claim.
stationary_control_note: Re-sample the same stationary A training pool; optimization-drift control, not a fresh-data control.

data_roles.pilot: Fresh compact 400Hz data; v1 binary trajectories/caches were removed at user request. Existing weights/reports support design only. No new confirmatory test access.
data_roles.split_by: Independent generated terrain seeds and trajectories; no frame-wise random train/test split.
data_roles.target_test_final_policy: No scoring until all requested methods and checkpoint schedules are locked; any later revision uses a new version and fresh final test seeds.

training.stage0_checkpoint: Final update, including matching optimizer state; stage0 sees A only.
training.normalization: Fit on A train only, freeze throughout sequence.
training.optimizer: Clone stage0 Adam state across methods; no task-boundary reset or test-guided stopping.
training.schedule_note: Candidate budgets and learning rates must pass pilot sufficiency check and be locked before confirmatory training/test. No guarantee that these budgets are converged.
training.budget_rule: Fixed total 2048 rows and identical update counts. Replay replaces current rows; does not append a larger batch.

memory.unit: One robot-policy interval, all four feet, full causal history payload; not a disk index into unlimited old data.
memory.counted_bytes: Payload arrays, stored predictions/metadata if any, RNG/counters, pending contexts, indices and deduplication tables; report serialized bytes and actual allocated storage separately.
memory.stratum_score: Maximum impact20 over four feet in this interval.
memory.sampling: Uniform reservoir within each stratum. Draw using current nonempty-buffer proportions q_s; replay loss weight (N_s/N)/q_s. Counter state observes past training labels only; no clipped weights in primary method.
memory.update_order: Evaluate incoming block before training; learn with current block and preceding memory; insert each unique block row exactly once after learning. Stage0 memory insertion is chronological, one pass.
memory.packet_replay: Deferred secondary ablation only after transition-level comparison; must beat an equal-length random-packet baseline at equal bytes and effective loss-row budget.

alarms.thresholds: Fixed initial-A threshold for retention; separate explicitly privileged recalibration diagnostic on equal calibration access.
alarms.probability_calibration: Initial-A calibrator frozen for main retention; raw AP and uncalibrated probabilities also retained.
alarms.verification: Geometrically disjoint calibration selection/verification tiles; no iterative threshold changes based on verification or test results.
alarms.ood_claim: Static U is never called forgetting. No FAR guarantee on future unseen scenes.

statistics.primary_retention_endpoint: Final macro AP over old domains A and B after C, with per-domain baselines after first learning.
statistics.primary_familywise_rule: Holm-adjust the two directional superiority tests against +0.01; report paired effects and pointwise 95% CIs. New-C noninferiority requires lower 95% CI above -0.01 versus each comparator.
statistics.alarm_gate: Operational claim additionally requires FAR upper clustered 95% bound <=1 for both compared methods at pre-fixed operating points; zero-count degenerate bootstrap does not certify a bound.
statistics.resampling: Paired collection replications, then terrain tiles within family strata; correlated feet/frames are not independent replications.

storage.policy: v1 raw/cache binaries removed by explicit user request; weights, reports, methods, metadata and historical hashes retained. New collector streams exact v1 labels to compact records and retains predetermined native-trace audit samples. Measure projected peak before new full-scale collection; do not accumulate redundant full raw+cache copies.

stopping_rules: If A-only stage0 is insufficiently trained in fresh compact pilot data, fix the shared budget before confirmation; do not manufacture forgetting by undertraining.
If finetune has no meaningful old-domain forgetting after new-domain learning, report that replay is unnecessary under this setting.
If memory improves old tasks but violates new-task noninferiority, report a stability-plasticity tradeoff.
If severity memory only beats uniform but not binary balancing, do not claim severity-specific innovation.
If FAR shifts while AP remains stable, do not label this pure representational forgetting.
No online hardware learning claim without an independently validated real supervisory source.
execution_scope: Five collections x two initializations, D/BCE primary only. Secondary loss/task/order/memory-size ablations remain unexecuted. Actual configuration in continual_replay_v1_lock.json.
